Done. The pruned checkpoint is written and passed all required checks on the first execution.

- **Solution** `out/T2/solution.py` loads both shards via the index, removes rows 640..767 from every q/k/v projection and columns 640..767 from every o_proj using one shared keep-index vector, then saves a single safetensors file.
- **Checks** enforced before writing: layer 0 q/k/v are `[1920, 2048]`, o_proj is `[2048, 1920]`, tensor count is 114, all dtypes float32. The script exits non-zero on any failure.
- **Output** `out/T2/model.safetensors` has 114 tensors. A spot check of a later layer's o_proj confirmed `[2048, 1920]`.
- **Report** `out/T2/REPORT.md` records one execution, no failures, and the tools used (safetensors 0.5.3 and torch 2.14.0, with a note on why `prune_heads` was not used).
